initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Multiple Items
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out to request a quote for a selection of products for an upcoming event. I am not sure if you require any specific account information, but please let me know if you need further details about my organization or background. For the quote, please include the following:

- 2 units of Pizza (please specify available options if there are differences)

Best regards,
Unknown Sender 11

test_cases.name: Verbose unknown sender quote request with intervention trigger
test_cases.description: A verbose, polite quote request from an unknown sender, including detailed context and a mix of catalog and non-catalog items. The request contains at least one item that cannot be matched to the available catalog, triggering an intervention due to unresolved customer identity and unresolvable item reference.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote – Product Details and Context
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out from an external organization and would like to request a quote for several items, as we are planning to expand our inventory for an upcoming event. I am not sure if my contact details are already registered in your system, so please let me know if you require any additional information about our company or the purchasing process.

For the quote, please include:
- 2 units of Rug (we are interested in both decorative and utility types, so please advise on available options)
- 1 set of SmartToys Jigsaw Puzzle Set
- 3 packs of EcoFresh Cleaning Wipes (this is a new product we heard about, but I could not locate it in your catalog; please confirm availability)
- 5 T-Shirts (preferably in assorted colors)

If you need further details regarding our organization or the event, I am happy to provide more context. Thank you in advance for your assistance, and I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
Unknown Sender 8

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Several Items (New Customer Inquiry)
initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

Hope you’re having a good day! I’m reaching out because I’d like to get a quote for a few things for an upcoming event we’re organizing. I’m not sure if you have my info on file yet, as this is my first time contacting your team, but I’ve heard good things about your service from a colleague who ordered recently.

Here’s what I’m looking for:
- 3 x T-Shirt (I saw you have a few different ones, but just the regular T-Shirt is fine for now)
- 2 x WonderWagon Electric Train (these are for a kids’ activity area)
- 1 x Deluxe Picnic Basket Set (this is the main item we need for our VIP guests—please include this in the quote)

If you need any more details from me or if you need to set up an account, just let me know what info you need. I’m happy to provide whatever’s required to get things moving. Thanks a lot for your help!

Best,
Unknown Sender 9

Best regards,
Unknown Sender 9
